suppressions.justification: math/rand is intentional for ML data augmentation and benchmark randomization — not security-sensitive.
int64→int32 and int→int32 conversions are bounded by protobuf field limits (max int32). Values come from internal metrics counters that never exceed int32 range in practice.
File paths come from embedded FS or trusted config — not from user input.
AccessToken JSON field name matches API contract. The actual token value is never logged or exposed.
Output path is validated against path traversal before WriteFile call. See lines 173-175.
